title: Protobuf: Display timestamp for google.protobuf.Timestamp while pbf_as_hf is FALSE
description:
## 1. Fix the bug that the timestamp of google.protobuf.Timestamp message type does not displayed while pbf_as_hf (Dissect Protobuf fields as Wireshark fields) is FALSE.

When pbf_as_hf=TRUE, the timestamp of google.protobuf.Timestamp will display:
```
Frame 16: 124 bytes on wire (992 bits), 124 bytes captured (992 bits) on interface \Device\NPF_Loopback, id 0
Null/Loopback
Internet Protocol Version 4, Src: 127.0.0.1, Dst: 127.0.0.1
Transmission Control Protocol, Src Port: 50051, Dst Port: 51035, Seq: 117, Ack: 226, Len: 80
HyperText Transfer Protocol 2
GRPC Message: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search, Response
Protocol Buffers: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search,response (Message: tutorial.Person)
    name: Jason
    id: 1001
    email: Jason@example.com
    phone: (12 bytes) (Message: tutorial.Person.PhoneNumber)
    phone: (13 bytes) (Message: tutorial.Person.PhoneNumber)
    last_updated: Oct 13, 2020 23:11:26.000000000 .... (Message: google.protobuf.Timestamp)
```

But the timestamp will not display if pbf_as_hf=FALSE:
```
Frame 16: 124 bytes on wire (992 bits), 124 bytes captured (992 bits) on interface \Device\NPF_Loopback, id 0
Null/Loopback
Internet Protocol Version 4, Src: 127.0.0.1, Dst: 127.0.0.1
Transmission Control Protocol, Src Port: 50051, Dst Port: 51035, Seq: 117, Ack: 226, Len: 80
HyperText Transfer Protocol 2
GRPC Message: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search, Response
Protocol Buffers: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search,response
    Message: tutorial.Person
        Field(1): name = Jason (string)
        Field(2): id = 1001 (int32)
        Field(3): email = Jason@example.com (string)
        Field(4): phone  (message)
        Field(4): phone  (message)
        Field(5): last_updated  (message)  <---- The timestamp value is missing
```

When the new change applied:
```
Frame 16: 124 bytes on wire (992 bits), 124 bytes captured (992 bits) on interface \Device\NPF_Loopback, id 0
Null/Loopback
Internet Protocol Version 4, Src: 127.0.0.1, Dst: 127.0.0.1
Transmission Control Protocol, Src Port: 50051, Dst Port: 51035, Seq: 117, Ack: 226, Len: 80
HyperText Transfer Protocol 2
GRPC Message: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search, Response
Protocol Buffers: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search,response
    Message: tutorial.Person
        Field(1): name = Jason (string)
        Field(2): id = 1001 (int32)
        Field(3): email = Jason@example.com (string)
        Field(4): phone  (message)
        Field(4): phone  (message)
        Field(5): last_updated = 2020-10-13T23:11:26+0800 (message)  <--- Timestamp displayed
```

>You can get this sample capture file and configure Protobuf search path according to https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/grpc (grpc_person_search_protobuf_with_image.pcapng)

## 2. Add the use_utc preference for display google.protobuf.Timestamp in UTC or local zone format:

When use_utc=FALSE:
```
Frame 16: 124 bytes on wire (992 bits), 124 bytes captured (992 bits) on interface \Device\NPF_Loopback, id 0
...
GRPC Message: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search, Response
Protocol Buffers: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search,response
...
        Field(5): last_updated = 2020-10-13T23:11:26+0800 (message)
```

When use_utc=TRUE:
```
Frame 16: 124 bytes on wire (992 bits), 124 bytes captured (992 bits) on interface \Device\NPF_Loopback, id 0
...
GRPC Message: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search, Response
Protocol Buffers: /tutorial.PersonSearchService/Search,response
...
        Field(5): last_updated = 2020-10-13T15:11:26Z (message)
```

commits_data.message:
Protobuf: Fix a google.protobuf.Timestamp displaying bug

1. Fix the bug that the timestamp of google.protobuf.Timestamp message
   type does not displayed while pbf_as_hf (Dissect Protobuf fields as
   Wireshark fields) is FALSE.

2. Add the use_utc preference for displaying google.protobuf.Timestamp
  in UTC or local zone format.
